hypothesis: A fixed-budget endpoint can reproduce a fixed subset of training-seen PurePosixPath question-and-answer pairs in their original chat prompts.
limitations: This is a training-seen acquisition check only. It provides no evidence of unseen-input generalization, independent semantics, Python-version portability, or architectural superiority. It must not select a checkpoint, seed, or rerun. The 0.0 controls are deliberate non-claims: this finite authored oracle-answer pool supplies no open-vocabulary chance baseline. Literal scoring trims only outer reply whitespace; case, Unicode composition, and internal whitespace remain significant.
